label: Douyin
terms_note: Developer registration (企业 or 个人) + per-capability application (能力申请) + app review on the Douyin Open Platform; enterprise qualification for several scopes; historic cap of a fixed number of API publishes per user per app per day; automation of personal accounts outside the Open Platform breaks the 抖音 user agreement.

tools.endpoint: POST api/douyin/v1/video/create_image_text/ (图文) — existence not verified this pass

reference.limits: - Historic publish cap: a fixed number of API publishes per user per app per day (from the old doc, now 404). - Douyin Open Platform developer agreement; enterprise qualification for anchors / several scopes; personal account automation outside the platform violates the 抖音用户协议.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: the current OpenAPI list (https://developer.open-douyin.com/docs/resource/zh-CN/dop/develop/openapi/list) still has no server-side publish, comment or delete call - its video entries are 查询视频分享结果及数据 (share_id for the client Share SDK; the result arrives by webhook, https://developer.open-douyin.com/docs/resource/zh-CN/dop/develop/openapi/video-management/douyin/search-video/video-share-result), 查询视频基础信息, iframe-code helpers, 抖音视频搜索 and mini-program/promotion task calls; posting goes through '调用分享 SDK' after POST https://open.douyin.com/share-id/. Token refresh also needs a client_key form field (https://developer.open-douyin.com/docs/resource/zh-CN/dop/develop/openapi/account-permission/refresh-access-token). No social verb maps to a server call.
